## Core Focus

## Personal Open-Source QA Tools (Desensitized)
- EvalGate (https://github.com/1dulei/evalgate): Zero-dependency Python 3.10+ release-gate evaluation harness for LLM features with deterministic assertions, optional LLM-as-judge contradiction checks, and ordered red-team leak/refusal checks.
- SpecGate (https://github.com/1dulei/specgate): Zero-dependency Python 3.11 pre-QA PRD contract extractor (SHA-256 digest, non_executable) and unified diff risk scanner covering 11 rules across added and removed lines (4 seed + 6 hard benchmark cases with documented limitations).
- TracePilot (https://github.com/1dulei/tracepilot): Playwright browser flow probe using semantic locators with component-library fallbacks, popup tab capture, and configurable passive API/localStorage security checks.
